models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description: Product categories for organizing items in the shopping mall. Each category represents a classification group that products can belong to, supporting hierarchical organization with multilingual support. Categories help customers navigate products efficiently and enable targeted promotions. Derived from systematic component, this table serves as a reference for product listings across all sellers.

plainFields.name: name

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: priority

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description: Sales channels representing different methods of product distribution within the shopping mall platform. Channels allow sellers to offer products through various strategies like direct online sales, marketplace, or wholesale channels. Each channel maintains separate pricing and terms, supporting flexible business models.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description:
Platform sections defining different areas or departments within the shopping mall. Sections organize the platform into logical divisions, supporting hierarchical structures with parent-child relationships. This enables complex navigation patterns and specialized marketplace areas.

The hierarchical design allows for unlimited nesting levels, enabling complex organizational structures. Each section can contain sub-sections, creating a tree-like navigation system. Priority fields enable custom ordering within each level of the hierarchy.

Visibility controls determine which sections are publicly accessible, supporting phased rollouts or maintenance modes. Soft deletion preserves historical navigation patterns while removing outdated sections.

foreignFields.name: parent_section_id
foreignFields.description: Parent section for hierarchical organization. References shopping_mall_sections.id to create hierarchical relationships.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Section name for navigation and display. Must be unique within the same parent level, but can repeat across different hierarchy branches.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the section's purpose and contents. Helps users understand what to expect from this section.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Display order within parent section, lower numbers appear first. Enables custom ordering that respects hierarchical structure.

plainFields.name: is_visible
plainFields.description: Whether this section is publicly visible in navigation. Allows hidden sections for setup or maintenance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created. Tracks when navigation structure was established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was last modified. Monitors changes to navigation structure.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted. Preserves navigation history while hiding outdated sections.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Customer accounts representing users who browse and purchase products on the shopping mall platform. 

Customers are the primary purchasing actors who register accounts to complete orders, track purchases, and manage their preferences. Each customer maintains authentication credentials and can create multiple shipping addresses. The customer entity serves as the central user identity for all ordering and shopping activities.

Customers can independently create accounts without seller or admin involvement, manage their personal information, and access complete order history. This table establishes the foundation for personalized shopping experiences and customer relationship management.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for customer registration and authentication. This serves as the unique identifier for login and receives transactional notifications, order confirmations, and password recovery emails. The address must follow standard email format and is used for all customer communications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed version of customer password for secure authentication. Password must be at least 8 characters with complex requirements. Used during login to verify user identity and should never be stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer account was first registered. Used for account age tracking and audit purposes, displaying join date in user profile.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last customer profile modification. Tracks account maintenance activities and profile updates for data integrity.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for customer accounts. Allows preserving historical order data while preventing new logins and purchases. Customers can be restored within data retention policies.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking customer device access and login activities for security monitoring.

Customer sessions record each login instance with device information, access timestamps, and IP tracking for security auditing and account activity monitoring. These sessions enable persistent authentication while tracking user engagement patterns.

Sessions capture connection context at login time, including IP addresses and referrer URLs, supporting fraud detection and security investigations. Each customer can maintain multiple concurrent sessions across different devices and browsers.

Sessions expire automatically after extended periods of inactivity to ensure account security, requiring re-authentication for continued access.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Target shopping_mall_customers.id identifier for the authenticated customer session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used by the customer device during authentication. Enables geographic and security analysis, tracking login locations and detecting suspicious access patterns.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL accessed by customer during connection initiation, typically the login page or checkout process. Useful for tracking user journey and authorization context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the customer's browser, indicating the page that linked to the login process. Helps understand user navigation patterns and potential security issues.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer session was established through successful authentication. Marks the start of authenticated activity tracking.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer session naturally expired or was terminated. Used for session lifecycle management and activity reporting.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Seller accounts representing merchants who list and manage products on the shopping mall platform.

Sellers are independent merchants with their own product catalogs, inventory management, and order fulfillment responsibilities. Each seller maintains authentication credentials including multi-factor authentication for enhanced security. Sellers independently create accounts, establish business profiles, and operate their marketplace presence.

Sellers handle product pricing, inventory tracking, and customer service for their listings. This table supports the core business model of connecting sellers with customers in a scalable marketplace.

Seller accounts enable commission-based revenue sharing while providing sellers with comprehensive authentication security including mandatory MFA requirements.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for seller registration and authentication. Serves as the unique identifier for login and receives critical notifications about orders, inventory alerts, and platform updates. Must be a business email for verification purposes.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed version of seller password for secure authentication. Password must meet complexity requirements including minimum length and character variety. Critical for protecting merchant account access and business data.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is activated for this seller account. Required by security policy to be enabled for all seller accounts to protect business operations and customer data.

plainFields.name: mfa_method
plainFields.description: The multi-factor authentication method configured for this seller account. Valid values: 'sms' for SMS verification, 'email' for additional email verification, 'app' for authenticator app integration. Required when MFA is enabled.

plainFields.name: mfa_secret
plainFields.description: Secret key used for authenticator app-based MFA integration. Stored securely and used to verify time-based one-time passwords. Only populated when mfa_method is 'app'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller account was first registered and approved. Used for seller onboarding tracking and establishing account seniority in performance reporting.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last seller profile or settings modification. Tracks account maintenance and business profile updates for audit and compliance purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for seller accounts. Preserves historical product and order data while preventing new listings and access. Supports seller re-enrollment if affairs are resolved.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking seller device access and login activities for business account monitoring.

Seller sessions record each login instance with device information and access tracking for security auditing and business activity monitoring. These sessions support multi-device access for merchants managing their online business.

Sessions capture connection context including IP addresses and access URLs, enabling security monitoring and fraud prevention for seller accounts. Multiple concurrent sessions allow sellers to manage their business from different devices.

Sessions provide audit trails for business activities and help monitor seller engagement with the marketplace platform.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Target shopping_mall_sellers.id identifier for the authenticated seller session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used by the seller device during authentication. Supports geographic analysis and detection of unauthorized access to business accounts.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL accessed by seller during connection initiation, typically dashboard or inventory management pages. Tracks business activity entry points.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the source page that led to seller authentication. Helps understand seller workflow and navigation patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller session was established through successful authentication. Marks the beginning of business activity auditing period.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller session was terminated through logout or automatic expiration. Supports session lifecycle reporting and security monitoring.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Administrator accounts representing platform operators who oversee and manage the shopping mall ecosystem.

Administrators are platform operators responsible for system integrity, user support, and operational management. They maintain authentication credentials including multi-factor authentication for enhanced security. Admins independently manage their operator accounts, handle user disputes, moderate content, and monitor platform performance.

Admins ensure fair marketplace practices and technical operations while maintaining audit trails for all administrative actions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for admin registration and authentication. Serves as the unique identifier for login and receives critical system alerts, user escalations, and platform maintenance notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed version of admin password for secure authentication. Requires enhanced complexity for high-privilege accounts with regular password rotation policies.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is activated for this admin account. Required by security policy to be enabled for all administrator accounts to protect platform operations and sensitive data access.

plainFields.name: mfa_method
plainFields.description: The multi-factor authentication method configured for this admin account. Valid values: 'sms' for SMS verification, 'email' for additional email verification, 'app' for authenticator app integration. Required when MFA is enabled.

plainFields.name: mfa_secret
plainFields.description: Secret key used for authenticator app-based MFA integration. Stored securely and used to verify time-based one-time passwords. Only populated when mfa_method is 'app'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was first created and authorized. Used for access privilege tracking and administrative role assignments.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last admin profile or permission modification. Tracks administrative account maintenance and access right changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for admin accounts. Preserves administrative action history while revoking access permissions. Supports account deactivation for compliance purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking administrator device access and login activities for platform security monitoring.

Admin sessions record each login instance with detailed tracking for security auditing and access control monitoring. These sessions support privileged account usage with enhanced security requirements.

Sessions capture comprehensive connection context including IP addresses and access patterns, enabling security monitoring and compliance reporting for administrative activities. Multiple sessions allow operators to manage different aspects of the platform.

Sessions provide audit trails for all administrative actions and help maintain accountability for platform modifications and user management decisions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Target shopping_mall_admins.id identifier for the authenticated admin session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used by the admin device during authentication. Enables geographic tracking and enhances security analysis for privileged account access.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL accessed by admin during connection initiation, typically platform management or user administration pages. Tracks entry points for auditing purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the source that led to admin authentication. Supports workflow tracking and security monitoring.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin session was established through successful authentication. Marks the beginning of administrative activity audit period.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin session was terminated through logout or automatic expiration. Supports security monitoring and session accountability.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product catalog entries representing items available for purchase on the shopping mall platform.

Stores complete product information including basic metadata, categorization, and seller association. Each product serves as the parent entity for multiple variants that represent different configurations like sizes, colors, or styles. The product table maintains business integrity without embedding pricing or inventory data, which is properly normalized into the variants table.

Products are searchable and browsable independently, supporting primary stance with full CRUD API endpoints for seller management. The product description serves as the foundation for detailed product presentations, while variants handle specific purchasing options.

Key relationships include categorization through the category foreign key and seller ownership through the seller association. Soft deletion is supported to maintain referential integrity while allowing product retirement.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category classification for the product. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Associated seller who manages this product. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name/title displayed in catalog and search results. Must be unique within seller's catalog to prevent confusion.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description providing comprehensive information about features, specifications, and usage. Supports rich text formatting for enhanced presentation.

plainFields.name: base_sku
plainFields.description: Base SKU identifier for the product, used as prefix for variant SKUs. Helps track product families while ensuring unique identification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product availability status. Valid values: active, inactive, discontinued. Controls whether product appears in search and browsing interfaces.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was first created in the system. Essential for audit trails and chronological sorting.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to product information. Supports caching invalidation and change tracking.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to maintain product references while removing from active catalog. Allows recovery and maintains historical orders.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Product variant configurations that extend base products with specific purchasing options.

Provides granular control over product variations including different sizes, colors, styles, and material options. Each variant contains individual pricing and inventory management, supporting precise e-commerce operations without denormalizing data into the parent product table. This separate table maintains strict 3NF compliance while enabling flexible product catalog management.

Variants are managed through parent product relationships with subsidiary stance, meaning they are created and updated via product management APIs. Each variant represents a distinct SKU that customers can select during the purchase process, with independent stock levels and pricing.

The table supports multiple attribute dimensions to handle complex product variations while maintaining data integrity. Foreign keys ensure variants are properly associated with their parent products.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product this variant belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique SKU identifier for this specific variant, combining parent product SKU with variant attributes. Used for inventory tracking and order processing.

plainFields.name: variant_attributes
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted variant specifications like size, color, or style combinations. Enables flexible product configurations while maintaining structured data integrity.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Specific price point for this variant in decimal format. Supports different pricing strategies across variant combinations while maintaining precision.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Available inventory units for this specific variant. Must be maintained accurately to prevent overselling during concurrent purchases.

plainFields.name: stock_status
plainFields.description: Current availability status for the variant. Valid values: in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock. Automatically calculated based on stock_quantity thresholds.

plainFields.name: images
plainFields.description: JSON array of image URLs specific to this variant configuration. Supports multiple images for different variant appearances.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was first created. Supports audit trails and chronological variant management.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to variant information. Essential for stock level change tracking and price updates.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for variant retirement while maintaining historical order references. Allows variant lifecycle management.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Customer feedback and rating system for products purchased on the platform.

Captures authentic customer experiences through rating scores and detailed feedback comments. Reviews serve as independent entities that users can create, read, update, and delete, supporting primary stance with full CRUD API endpoints. This design enables customers to manage their feedback independently across different devices and sessions.

Each review validates against purchase history to ensure authenticity, requiring both customer and product relationships. The review system supports multiple reviews per customer-product combination when customers make repeated purchases, enabling ongoing feedback updated after multiple experiences. Soft deletion is supported to handle review moderation while maintaining data integrity.

Reviews are indexed for full-text search on content and comments, supporting platform-wide sentiment analysis and customer feedback aggregation. The table includes comprehensive audit trails with creation and update timestamps.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this review for purchase validation. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numeric rating score from 1 to 5 stars. Provides quantitative feedback that supports average calculations and sorting.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Review headline or summary title. Provides quick overview and supports search indexing for customer feedback.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Detailed review content and comments. Contains customer feedback, experiences, and specific observations about the product.

plainFields.name: verified_purchase
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the review comes from a verified purchase. Builds trust and prevents fake reviews.

plainFields.name: helpful_votes
plainFields.description: Community helpfulness score based on customer upvoting. Supports review ranking and quality identification.

plainFields.name: moderation_status
plainFields.description: Current moderation status of the review. Valid values: pending, approved, rejected, flagged. Controls review visibility to other customers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was first submitted. Critical for chronological display and review freshness assessment.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to review content. Supports edit tracking and moderation changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to handle review removal while preserving order references and providing recovery options.

models.name: shopping_mall_coupons
models.description: Coupon definitions and configurations for promotional discount campaigns. Supports various discount types including percentage discounts, fixed amount reductions, and special offer promotions. Each coupon has unique code for customer redemption, configurable usage limits, and time-based validity windows. Coupons can be targeted at specific customer segments or applied platform-wide.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique coupon code for customer redemption. Case-insensitive but stored in uppercase for consistency.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Discount calculation method: 'percentage' for percent-off, 'fixed' for dollar amount reduction, 'free_shipping' for shipping waivers.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Discount amount or percentage value depending on type field. For percentage type, represents percent (e.g., 15.0 for 15% off).

plainFields.name: minimum_order_amount
plainFields.description: Minimum cart subtotal required for coupon application. Prevents misuse on small orders.

plainFields.name: usage_limit
plainFields.description: Maximum number of redemptions allowed across all customers. Null indicates unlimited usage.

plainFields.name: usage_limit_per_customer
plainFields.description: Maximum redemptions per individual customer. Prevents single customer abuse.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Coupon expiration date and time. Coupons become unusable after this timestamp.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the coupon is currently available for redemption. Allows for temporary deactivation without deletion.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Coupon creation timestamp for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for tracking coupon updates.

models.name: shopping_mall_coupon_redemptions
models.description: Records of individual coupon usage instances. Tracks which coupon was applied to which cart or order, when it was redeemed, and by which customer. Supports audit trails for discount applications and prevents double-redemption through unique constraints.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_coupon_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the applied coupon. {@link shopping_mall_coupons.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who redeemed the coupon. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Customer wishlists for saving desired products for future purchase consideration.

This entity manages user-created lists where customers can collect and organize products they are interested in buying later. Each wishlist belongs to exactly one customer and can contain multiple product items. Wishlists enhance the shopping experience by allowing customers to track items across browsing sessions and receive notifications when items become restocked or go on sale.

Wishlists support multiple lists per customer for organizational purposes, such as gift lists, personal purchases, or saving items for different shopping occasions. The system maintains audit trails for wishlist creation and modifications to support user account management and historical tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description:
Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

Foreign key linking the wishlist to the customer who created and owns it.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Wishlist name chosen by the customer for easy identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the wishlist's purpose or contents.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the wishlist.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail and potential recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Individual product items within customer wishlists.

This entity connects specific product variants to wishlists, allowing customers to save particular product configurations. Each wishlist item represents one product variant that a customer has added to their wishlist. Items include optional quantity information for customers who are saving multiple units of the same product.

Wishlist items enable customers to track product availability changes, receive restock notifications, and move items to their shopping cart when ready to purchase. The system prevents duplication of the same product variant within a single wishlist.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description:
Belonged wishlist's {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the wishlist.

Inquiries enable customers to ask questions about products, sellers, or platform services, supporting the marketplace's communication needs. Each inquiry is created by a logged-in customer and may be associated with specific sellers or products. Inquiries remain accessible even after responses are provided, maintaining a complete conversation history.

plainFields.name: body
